text: Bad news. All paper just vanished. For five seconds.
Your coffee cup? Paper. Just the plastic lining is left. Hot coffee. Your shoes.
Every cardboard box. Gone. The forklift guy? Buried in rubber ducks.
Drywall is gypsum wrapped in paper. Your walls crumble. Hi, neighbor. Nice karaoke.
Eggs in paper cartons. Milk cartons. Flour bags. Aisle five is now pancake batter.
Toilet paper. Gone. A million people are mid wipe. Pray for them.
Paper's back. Your cup is back. Empty. The coffee is in your socks.
Good news. Your cash survived. It's made of cotton. You're still broke, though.
What should vanish next? Comment it, or I pick something worse.
